data: What is the epoch value when the blue line in the bottom plot is at its peak?

The blue line in the bottom plot represents the False Hateful Rate. To determine the epoch value when this line is at its peak, we need to identify the highest point on the blue line within the range of epochs shown in the x-axis. 

From the analysis of the figure, the blue line reaches its peak at approximately epoch 8. Therefore, the epoch value when the blue line in the bottom plot is at its peak is **8**.
